title: Episode 2: Potato Lovers
method: Potatoes, sliced + maida + salt + red chilli powder + black pepper
Butter + minced garlic + ketchup + sweet chilli sauce+ barbeque + soy sauce
The glaze is a delicate balance of what you would like to enjoy and it allows you to customize the flavour
Want a classic potato lovers flavour - go all tomato ketchup and and 1/4 tsp of the other ingredients
Want a more umami flavour for our aged taste buds - 3-5 tbsp ketchup + 1 tbsp each of the sauces

Episode 2: Potato Lovers

potatoes, sliced + maida + salt + red chilli powder + black pepper

Glaze:
Butter + minced garlic + ketchup + sweet chilli sauce+ barbeque + soy sauce 
the glaze is a delicate balance of what you would like to enjoy and it allows you to customize the flavour
want a classic potato lovers flavour - go all tomato ketchup and and 1/4 tsp of the other ingredients
want a more umami flavour for our aged taste buds - 3-5 tbsp ketchup + 1 tbsp each of the sauces

Enjoy :)
